description: Pittston, PA — Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s campaign today announced that he has earned the endorsement of the National Electrical Contractors Association (NECA), which cited his leadership on infrastructure policy and deep understanding of the skilled trades workforce. NECA’s endorsement adds to a growing list of labor organizations throwing their support behind Bresnahan.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: National Electrical Contractors Association PAC Endorses Rob Bresnahan for Congress - Rob for PA
